description: This Java source file defines the ProductPriceUtils class, a utility component in the Shopizer e-commerce platform. It provides methods for calculating product prices, formatting amounts with currencies, handling discounts, and managing price representations for products and attributes within a store context.

classes.name: ProductPriceUtils
classes.description: A utility component providing pricing calculations, formatting, and discount logic for products within the Shopizer e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getPrice
methods.description: Retrieves the default (non-discounted) price of a product from its availabilities.

methods.name: getFinalProductPrice
methods.description: Calculates the final price of a product including selected attributes, based on the default price.

methods.name: getFinalPrice
methods.description: Calculates the overall final price of a product based on available prices, attributes, and discounts.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmount
methods.description: Formats a BigDecimal amount into a raw string suitable for admin input, respecting locale formatting.

methods.name: getStoreFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with currency considering store's locale and currency format preferences.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with currency using a specified locale and currency.

methods.name: getAdminFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats an amount with store's currency for admin purposes.

methods.name: getFormatedAmountWithCurrency
methods.description: Formats amount with currency for a given Currency object and locale.

methods.name: getAmount
methods.description: Parses a string input into a BigDecimal amount, handling locale-specific formats.

methods.name: getOrderProductTotalPrice
methods.description: Calculates total price for an order product based on quantity and unit price.

methods.name: hasDiscount
methods.description: Determines if a product price has an active discount based on its start and end dates.

methods.name: calculateFinalPrice
methods.description: Internal method to compute the final price of a product considering multiple availabilities.

methods.name: finalPrice
methods.description: Creates a FinalPrice object from a ProductPrice, applying discount logic if applicable.

methods.name: discountPrice
methods.description: Calculates and sets discount percentage and discounted price for a FinalPrice object.
